title: Order confirmation message
description: Confirm a new order on WhatsApp with order number, total and a link to the receipt. Utility template for online stores. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Keep it strictly transactional; adding a coupon or cross-sell flips Meta's classifier to marketing. Trigger it right after payment clears.

body.text: Thanks for your order, {{first_name}}! We received order *#{{order_id}}* totaling {{amount}} and we're getting it ready now.
